source.written: by hand, 2026-09-09; the body it describes re-cut 2026-09-10

derived_from.how: dressup.prepare on that file: refit found nothing torn and copied it, then cover.trim deleted the body triangles the clothes cover, 11,940 of 31,009, guarded against holes over the 41 frames the clipping gate scores. The cut is 560 triangles of Body (merged), 48 of the face skin and 5,666 of each inner layer, and it converged in two rounds. Only the `indices` accessors differ: every POSITION, NORMAL, TEXCOORD_0, JOINTS_0, WEIGHTS_0 and morph target of all 17 primitives is byte-identical and so is every node transform, so the rig identity and the clearance measured on it still hold, the latter checked by re-running springsim.ts on this exact file (evidence/clearance-0910-shipped.log). Each index accessor was rewritten in place rather than appended, so the file is 143,284 bytes SMALLER than the one it was cut from. Receipt: scripts/avatar/evidence/cover-0910.md.

itself_derived_from.how: only the VRM meta's allowRedistribution, modification and avatarPermission were rewritten so the site may serve it; the document and the binary chunk are otherwise byte-identical, checked by putting the three values back and comparing both against the source.

source.why: build.py never built this body, so no build wrote its sidecar. springsim.ts deriveManifest reads one off the file instead, and on this file it finds 0 Hair_* parts: every primitive falls under SPRING_DOMINATED because none of this export's spring joints has weight on any drawn vertex. This file names the parts the derivation cannot, and receipt evidence/parts-0909.md records what was measured to name each one.

landmarks.waist_from: scripts/avatar/build.py landmarks() over InnerTop.baked[0], the unmasked body layer. NOT over Body (merged).baked(copy).baked[0]: the export's auto-mask hollows the torso wherever the hoodie covers it, leaving one slab of 14 vertices at y=0.9426 and none at all above y=1.06, so that mesh's minimum is where the hole ends rather than where the body is narrowest.

Face.note: the mesh the VRM expressions deform; 3989 vertices over mouth, iris, highlight, skin, white, brow, eyeline

Hair_Back.note: N00_000_00_HairBack_00_HAIR, 746 vertices, y 1.354..1.598, and the topmost vertex of the whole model. Rigid: its weight is J_Bip_C_Head 715.5, J_Bip_C_Neck 28.8, J_Bip_C_Chest 1.5, the two shoulders 0.3 between them, and none of those is a spring joint.

Body_Skin.note: the skin layer, y 0.015..1.593, head included. Auto-masked where the clothes cover it, which is why the waist landmark is read off InnerTop instead.

Body_Skin_Inner_Top.note: unmasked body layer the hoodie sits on, y 0.145..1.406

Body_Skin_Inner_Bottom.note: unmasked body layer the jeans sit on; POSITION is byte-identical to InnerTop's, the skins differ

Outfit_Cardigan.note: the hoodie. Named as the cardigan role so springsim measures its depth into the body; outerShellOnly and dropSleeves are geometric and apply to a closed pullover as much as to an open coat.

Outfit_Jeans.note: NOT named Outfit_Bottom: that role is the skirt, whose depth is measured against leg skin on the understanding that a skirt hangs clear of the legs. Trousers hug them by design, so the same number would mean something else.

Outfit_Shoes_Sole.note: 28 vertices of N00_004_01_Shoes_01_CLOTH left in the body mesh, y 0.000..0.003. Kept out of Body_Skin so the leg set stays skin.

Acc_Glasses.why: The temple arm passes from the lens behind the ear, and the ear sits 8.6 to 11.0mm nearer the camera than it, so all four of pierce.py's conditions pass on a frame that renders correctly: the gap is inside the 30mm window, the temple's outer face is toward the camera, head skin and head-driven cloth are both centred, and no arm is involved. Measured 2026-09-09 (evidence/parts-0909.md, pierce-0909-glasses.png) and again 2026-09-10 across all ten clips: the worst is 51 pixels at dance t=16.75s against a limit of 30, which FLOOR sets because the glasses cover only 1,043 pixels. 60 is that worst reading rounded up to the next ten; a real defect on a part this small would be several hundred.
